extraction.provider_name: The Christine W. Avery Learning Center
extraction.notes: No summer 2027 announcements or sufficiently documented 2026 summer camp programs were found in the supplied official pages or web searches. The current website describes early learning, after-school, music and workforce-development programs, but does not establish a separate summer camp offering. Additional .org pages and its sitemap returned no readable text; cwalearningcenter.com was blocked by robots.txt. Brightwheel forms require login. A partner's Youth Literacy page mentions Igniting Superhero Readers Summer Camp in 2021, but does not provide a current CWA summer offering, so no card was created from that historical reference.
